text: Deputy Governor of the State Bank of Vietnam (SBV), Mr. Pham Quang Dung, has been elected as Chairman of the Vietnam Chamber of Commerce and Industry (VCCI) for the 2021-2026 term, following his appointment as Secretary of the body's Party Committee for the 2026-2030 term.

Speaking after assuming his new post on November 16, Mr. Dung emphasized that the Party and the State place high expectations on businesses and entrepreneurs across all economic sectors, including state-owned enterprises, private companies, foreign-invested enterprises, cooperatives, and household businesses.
He noted that greater expectations also bring higher demands, particularly for businesses themselves and the organization that represent them.
Sharing his professional background, Dung said he has spent more than 32 years working in the banking sector, including positions in both commercial banks and the central bank.
He expressed his desire to contribute his experience to VCCI's activities and hoped that the SBV and the banking industry would continue working closely with VCCI and the broader business community.
